summary: Iteration 14 (Phase 3b — encrypted-at-rest webhook secrets + Fernet + PLAINTEXT HMAC signing + Documentation API page) validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_encrypted_webhook_secret.py — SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY loads as a valid Fernet key; fresh merchant's api_keys.webhook doc contains BOTH secret_hash (sha256) and secret_encrypted (Fernet ciphertext starting with 'gAAAAA') verified via direct MongoDB; Fernet.decrypt(secret_encrypted) == the plaintext returned in the one-time _reveal payload; sha256(plaintext) == secret_hash. Regenerate webhook secret rotates BOTH fields and the new decrypted ciphertext matches the newly-returned plaintext. CRITICAL ROUND-TRIP TEST PASSED: PATCH webhook URL → https://httpbin.org/post, regen sk_test_, POST /api/v1/payments, sleep 6s, GET /api-keys/webhook/deliveries, JSON-parse httpbin's echoed response_body, extract data + X-Biztranspay-Timestamp + X-Biztranspay-Signature from the echoed headers, then recompute 'sha256=' + HMAC(plaintext_webhook_secret, f'{ts}.{raw_body}') — the recomputed signature EXACTLY MATCHES the received one. Also verified the received sig does NOT match the hash-based signing path (proving the plaintext branch is exercised). Legacy fallback verified: manually $unset secret_encrypted → triggering a new payment.created webhook still delivers (status=delivered, httpbin 200) — no crash, signs with hash. Regression: /auth/me, /notifications, /exchange/rate, /v1/payments 401 auth all green. Frontend Playwright on live preview — merchant seeded via /auth/register + one-time reveal consumed twice via API + token injected → /dashboard/api page shows btn-open-docs (href=/dashboard/api/docs); ApiKeys 'Webhooks' tab pre now says 'YOUR_WEBHOOK_SECRET // whsec_... plaintext' (no more _HASH suffix); /dashboard/api/docs renders page-api-docs with all 7 sections (section-auth, section-create, section-retrieve, section-list, section-webhooks, section-errors, section-sdk); nav bar with SectionLink anchors is rendered (sticky class present in DOM — confirmed via screenshot); anchor href='#errors' scrolls & updates URL to /dashboard/api/docs#errors; 'Créer un paiement' LangTabs has 6 tabs (curl/node/javascript/python/php/laravel) all clickable and switch code content; 'Webhooks > Vérifier la signature' LangTabs has exactly 4 tabs (node/python/php/laravel — curl+javascript correctly absent); the Node.js verify snippet uses WEBHOOK_SECRET (no _HASH suffix) — Phase 3b intent respected; clicking Copy button on a CodeBlock triggers Sonner toast 'Code copié' (visible via body innerText).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py._deliver_webhook: OK — decrypts secret_encrypted via _decrypt() and signs with plaintext bytes when present; falls back to secret_hash bytes when not. That's the documented Phase 3b behavior. Good touch: legacy accounts still deliver — no crashes. Suggest surfacing a warning banner in the deliveries UI when the merchant's webhook doc lacks secret_encrypted so they know to regenerate.

SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is loaded once and cached in a module-level _FERNET. If .env is rotated the process must be restarted — fine, but document it in ops runbook. Also: if the key is EVER changed, every existing secret_encrypted becomes undecryptable and every webhook will silently fall back to hash-signing (which won't match what merchants copied). Consider key-versioning (e.g. store 'v1$gAAAAA…') to allow rotation with grace.
_encrypt/_decrypt are sync methods called from async endpoints — Fernet is fast (µs) so this is fine, but note it for consistency.
server.py is now ~2724 lines (was 2695). Router-split still overdue.
ApiDocs.js is 531 lines with inline CODE snippet constants — fine for now, but if more languages get added, extract snippets to a JSON/data module for easier maintenance.
The docs page CodeBlock 'Copy' button uses hover:opacity-100 with group-hover — mobile users (no hover) may not see it. Consider always-visible copy on <md screens.
No client-side syntax highlighting on CodeBlock — text is monospace but tokens aren't colored. Optional polish (prismjs/shiki).

rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Phase 3b delivers what it promised: HMAC signature on outbound webhooks is computed with the PLAINTEXT webhook secret (decrypted from Fernet ciphertext at rest). Merchants can now paste the plaintext secret they copied from the one-time reveal into their verify-signature code and it will match. Legacy iter13 accounts (no secret_encrypted) still get webhooks delivered — signature falls back to hash-based signing per the documented compromise.
